Container.Name: homeserver-portal
Container.Overview: Google-authenticated, invitation-only portal for lordblight.com. You invite each person by email from the admin UI; invited users sign in with their Google account and see tiles for only the services they have been granted (Immich, Nextcloud, 2FAuth, and anything added later). Includes per-user grants and a forward-auth endpoint so Nginx Proxy Manager can enforce access at the proxy. Full setup guide: https://github.com/rshaker2-ops/homeserver#readme

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Host port for the portal. NPM proxies www.lordblight.com to this port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite data directory. Keep it on the cache pool (/mnt/cache/...), NOT /mnt/user/... (FUSE breaks SQLite locking). One-time setup: chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/cache/appdata/portal

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: At least 32 random characters. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: ADMIN_EMAILS
Config.Description: Comma-separated Google account emails that get administrator access.

Config.Name: COOKIE_DOMAIN
Config.Description: Parent cookie domain, required for NPM forward-auth across the service subdomains.

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: Optional: SMTP server for emailing invitations (Gmail: smtp.gmail.com). Leave empty to hand out invite links manually from the admin UI.

Config.Name: SMTP_PASS
Config.Description: SMTP password (Gmail: an App Password from Google Account -> Security).

Config.Name: MAIL_FROM
Config.Description: Optional From header for invitation emails; defaults to SMTP_USER.

Config.Name: INVITE_EXPIRY_DAYS
Config.Description: Days an invitation stays valid before it must be resent.

Config.Name: ALLOWED_EMAILS
Config.Description: Optional: comma-separated emails that may sign in WITHOUT an invitation (admins always may). Most setups leave this empty and rely on invitations.

Config.Name: ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS
Config.Description: Optional: comma-separated email domains that may sign in without an invitation.

Config.Name: PORTAL_NAME
Config.Description: Name shown in the header and page titles.

Config.Name: SESSION_MAX_AGE_DAYS
Config.Description: How long a sign-in lasts before users must sign in again.
